title: Protective effect of a new heterocyclic compound on acute tracheobronchitis via reducing IL-6 and TNF- α content and PKA-NF- κ B pathway activation
abstract: The new heterocyclic compound 4-methyl-3-((4-(pyridin-3-yl) pyrimidin-2-yl) amino) benzoic acid (1) designed utilizing methyl 3-amino-4-methylbenzoate (2) as a starting material was successfully fabricated and eventually characterized utilizing single crystal X-ray crystallography,                     1                     H NMR and IR. In biological study, to evaluate the protective effect of compound on acute tracheobronchitis ICR mice model, the ELISA assay was performed to determine the level of inflammatory mediators IL-6 and TNF- α in serum. Then, the western blot was performed to determine the activation of PKA-NF- κB pathway in tissues.
